spans.title: The Cat and the Painkiller
spans.blurb: A boy offers his aunt's cat a taste of patent medicine, and the cat accepts. What follows involves flower pots, somersaults, and an open window.

spans.title: The Glorious Whitewasher
spans.blurb: Sentenced to whitewash thirty yards of fence on a perfect Saturday, a boy discovers a law of human nature that turns his punishment into a privilege.

books.pairNote: Two separate pranks from different days; neither borrows the other's payoff.

spans.title: The Signal at Midnight
spans.blurb: Alone at midnight, a superstitious boy reads doom in a shriveled spider, until a soft meow from the dark trees tells him adventure is waiting.

spans.title: Trapped on the Wreck
spans.blurb: Creeping through a wrecked steamboat in the dark, a boy overhears two men deciding how a third will die, then finds his own escape has floated away.

books.pairNote: A quiet night scene and a steamboat escapade, with no shared text or shared payoff.

spans.title: A Dreary Night of November
spans.blurb: On a rainy November night, after two years of secret labor, a young scientist watches a dull yellow eye open, and his dream curdles into horror.

spans.title: Creature and Creator
spans.blurb: High on a glacier, a maker meets the being he made and abandoned. The creature asks only to be heard, and his plea is harder to refuse than to hate.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals that the creature has already murdered the narrator's young brother, a death the book stages as a shock.

books.pairNote: The creation night and the glacier meeting are distinct scenes; each lands on its own.

spans.title: The Eclipse
spans.blurb: Chained to the stake before four thousand silent watchers, a condemned man bets his life on the sky going dark at exactly the right moment.
spans.spoilerNote: Gives away how the hero escapes execution, the payoff of the book's opening predicament.

spans.title: One Hundred and Five, North Tower
spans.blurb: A wine merchant turns cannonier as a living sea of people breaks against a fortress. When the towers fall, he wants one cell above all.
spans.brokenNote: The text stops in the middle of a sentence while describing the cell, so the story ends mid air.

spans.title: Four Minutes Too Slow
spans.blurb: A young Frenchman of many trades applies to serve the most exact gentleman in England, and learns his new master counts life in minutes.

spans.title: The Obvious Facts
spans.blurb: A wild eyed young man bursts in on two friends at breakfast, certain his name explains everything. His host knows only what a glance can tell, which is plenty.

spans.title: The Animal Charmer
spans.blurb: In a spring wood a girl finds a boy playing a wooden pipe while a squirrel, a pheasant, and two rabbits creep close to listen.

spans.title: A Battle of Looks
spans.blurb: In a quiet parlour, a drunken old seaman draws a knife on the one guest who refuses to be afraid of him.

spans.title: Black Dog Appears and Disappears
spans.blurb: A pale stranger missing two fingers waits behind an inn door for his old shipmate Bill, and the reunion ends in drawn cutlasses.

books.pairNote: Two different visitors menace the same inn guest, but each confrontation has its own arc and payoff.

spans.title: The Duties of a Partner
spans.blurb: At a ball, a young lady's new partner performs both halves of polite small talk, smirks included, and she can barely keep from laughing.

spans.title: Nerves Fit for Sliding Panels
spans.blurb: Riding toward an old abbey, a young reader of horrid novels hears her companion describe, in loving detail, the gloomy chamber and hidden manuscript awaiting her.

books.pairNote: Two separate flirtations built on the same teasing wit, with no shared text and separate punch lines.
